title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: Develop user-facing features in React, Tailwind, and UI/UX polish for BeatFlow Media. Work closely with product and design teams to create fast, accessible, beautiful experiences.
responsibilities: Build and ship React UI components.
Collaborate with designers and backend engineers.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsive design.
Contribute to UX polish and accessibility.
requirements: Proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
Familiarity with React Hooks, Context API.
Experience with testing (Jest/Cypress) is a plus.

title: Backend Engineer (Firebase/Cloud Functions)
description: Build and optimize Firestore queries, implement serverless logic using Firebase Cloud Functions, and ensure data integrity and security.
responsibilities: Design and implement backend logic in Cloud Functions.
Optimize Firestore data models and queries.
Work with authentication, security rules, and integrations.
Support analytics and business logic.
requirements: Familiarity with authentication and security best practices.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Work across frontend and backend, integrate features end-to-end, and ensure seamless functionality throughout the product.
responsibilities: Contribute to both frontend (React) and backend (Firebase) codebases.
Build and integrate new features end-to-end.
Maintain high code quality and documentation.
Participate in code reviews and team discussions.
requirements: Strong in both React and Node.js/Firebase.
Familiarity with CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

title: DevOps/Cloud Engineer
description: Manage deployments, Netlify CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. Ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of the BeatFlow Media platform.
responsibilities: Configure and maintain CI/CD (Netlify, GitHub).
Monitor cloud resources and performance.
Automate deployments and environment management.
Contribute to security and compliance best practices.
requirements: Experience with Netlify, Firebase Hosting, or AWS.
Understanding of security, monitoring, and backups.

title: Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description: Develop and maintain BeatFlow mobile applications using React Native. Collaborate with design and backend teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.
responsibilities: Build and optimize mobile app features.
Integrate with backend and authentication services.
Ensure cross-platform compatibility (iOS/Android).
Participate in app store submissions and updates.
requirements: Experience with mobile testing and debugging.
Strong knowledge of mobile UX best practices.

title: Product Manager
description: Define product roadmap, prioritize features, and work closely with designers and engineers to deliver exceptional user experiences.
responsibilities: Own the product roadmap and feature prioritization.
Gather requirements and feedback from users and stakeholders.
Work with design/dev to deliver product improvements.
Define and measure product success metrics.
requirements: Experience in music/entertainment or SaaS products is a plus.

title: UX/UI Designer
description: Design user flows, visual assets, and deliver a beautiful, user-friendly UI for BeatFlow Media using Figma or similar tools.
responsibilities: Design user journeys and app screens.
Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams.
Conduct usability tests and gather user feedback.
requirements: Experience with music, media, or entertainment apps is a plus.

title: QA Engineer / Test Automation Engineer
description: Write tests (unit/integration) and perform manual QA for new releases. Ensure product reliability and quality.
responsibilities: Write automated and manual tests.
Collaborate with devs to catch bugs early.
Document test cases and track issues.
Work on test automation pipelines.
requirements: Familiarity with Jest, Cypress, or similar.

title: Content Manager
description: Curate song/artist data, manage playlists, and approve uploads for BeatFlow Media. Work closely with artists and community.
responsibilities: Curate song/artist data and manage editorial playlists.
Approve new music uploads and monitor content quality.
Coordinate with artists and rights holders.
Assist with content marketing initiatives.
requirements: Experience managing digital music or content platforms.
Passion for music and strong knowledge of genres/artists.

title: Community Manager
description: Manage social media, help users, gather feedback, and support a thriving BeatFlow Media community.
responsibilities: Run social media accounts and engage with users.
Handle feedback and support requests.
Organize community events or contests.
Work with product to advocate for user needs.
requirements: Experience as a community manager or social media lead.
Passion for music and online communities.

title: Data Analyst
description: Track shares, plays, likes, and build dashboards from analytics to inform product and marketing decisions.
responsibilities: Track key user and product metrics.
Build analytics dashboards (Looker, Tableau, etc.).
Analyze campaigns, growth, and retention data.
Work with engineering to improve analytics pipelines.
requirements: Experience with Google Analytics, BigQuery, etc.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Future-facing role for building recommendation engines, music suggestions, and personalizing the BeatFlow Media experience.
responsibilities: Prototype and deploy music recommendation models.
Analyze listening and interaction data.
Work with data/engineering teams to productionize models.
Evaluate model effectiveness and user satisfaction.
requirements: Experience with ML and recommender systems.
Familiarity with music/audio data is a plus.
Ability to explain complex ideas to product teams.

title: Growth Marketer
description: Drive social media campaigns, user acquisition, and SEO strategies to grow BeatFlow Media.
responsibilities: Develop and execute user acquisition strategies.
Run and analyze marketing campaigns.
Manage SEO/SEM for maximum visibility.
Collaborate with content, community, and product.

title: Copywriter
description: Write content for landing pages, onboarding, sharing features, email, and push notifications for BeatFlow Media.
responsibilities: Create clear, concise, and engaging copy.
Support marketing and onboarding campaigns.
Write for web, email, and social.
Ensure brand voice and consistency.
requirements: Attention to tone, grammar, and clarity.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description: Handle user questions, bug reports, account issues, and help users have a great experience with BeatFlow Media.
responsibilities: Respond to user questions and support requests.
Troubleshoot account and technical issues.
Document feedback and escalate bugs.
Help onboard new users.

title: HR / Recruiter
description: Handle hiring and onboarding of new team members as BeatFlow Media grows.
responsibilities: Manage hiring pipeline and post new jobs.
Screen applicants and coordinate interviews.
Onboard new employees.
Support team growth and company culture.
requirements: Familiarity with ATS or hiring tools.
